purpose: Completes the sink-path handler set: poll (10/11/12), profile (0) and profile-request (30) join chat/reaction/delete-edit on {groupId,eventId,rumor,sender}; every kind gets a retract path (other members' content removed and unread recomputed; own chat to failed/retry via onOwnWithdrawn; own reactions/votes/edit/delete dropped); announcement, profile-request and admin gates read live group.members()/group.admins through an injected groupOf (undefined fails closed with the row marked dispatched, a rejection rejects the handler); follow-up client writes (profile-request replies, 'accepted' announcement) are enqueued on the owned FIFO as the handler's last action; a late retract caused by purge removes an own row instead of marking it failed/retry.

public_api.name: createGroupGates
public_api.signature: (groupOf: GroupOf) => { isGroupAdmin(groupId, pubkeyHex): Promise<boolean>; isGroupMember(groupId, pubkeyHex): Promise<boolean>; adminsOf(groupId): Promise<string[]> }
public_api.description: Live-accessor gates (group.members()/group.admins). groupOf resolving undefined => false/[] (fail closed); a rejection propagates.

public_api.name: createGroupAdminsProvider
public_api.description: Provider for messageEdits.registerGroupAdminsProvider backed by live group.admins (admin-only delete of announcements).

public_api.name: GroupOf
public_api.signature: (groupId: string) => Promise<{ members(): readonly string[]; readonly admins: readonly string[] } | undefined>

public_api.name: createPollOpenGroupHandler / createPollVoteGroupHandler / createPollCloseGroupHandler
public_api.description: Kinds 10/11/12 on the sink path with retract ports (retractPoll, retractVote, retractClose).

public_api.name: createProfileGroupHandler
public_api.description: Kind 0; the 'accepted' announcement send is enqueued on the FIFO as the last action; retract is a documented no-op (LWW identity metadata).

public_api.name: createProfileRequestGroupHandler
public_api.description: Kind 30; sender must be a live current member (groupOf), replies enqueued on the FIFO as the last action; retract is a no-op (replies are emitted effects).

public_api.name: createChatGroupHandler
public_api.description: Now takes groupOf (announcement gates from live accessors; lookup rejection rejects the row), releaseHeldReactions + setReactionsVersion (target landed), removeMessage (purged retract).

public_api.name: GroupRumorInput.reason
public_api.description: Absent = withdrawn. A late retract caused by purge carries 'purged': an own row is removed instead of failed/retry.

public_api.name: unreadStore.recomputeUnread
public_api.description: Count of non-own rows after lastRead over stored rows (shared predicate with initUnreadCounts); authoritative (0 clears).

public_api.name: recomputeSlot
public_api.signature: recomputeSlot(thread: MessageEditsThreadKey, slotIds: readonly string[], signals: readonly RecomputeSignal[], options?: {withdrawnRumorIds?: readonly string[]}): Promise<void>
public_api.description: messageEdits/api.ts: reset slots to the ChatMessage.original base and fold the remaining kind-5/edit-9 signals through the dispatch core (effect-free).

public_api.name: recomputeMessageReactions
public_api.signature: recomputeMessageReactions(thread: ReactionThreadKey, targetMessageId: string, signals: readonly RecomputeSignal[]): Promise<boolean>
public_api.description: reactions/api.ts: reset a message's reactions (keeping own unconfirmed optimistic rows) and fold remaining kind-7 signals; holds when the target is absent.

public_api.name: recomputePoll
public_api.signature: recomputePoll(groupId: string, pollId: string, signals: readonly RecomputeSignal[]): Promise<boolean>
public_api.description: pollPersistence.ts (fold in pollFold.ts over pollCore): rebuild one poll from empty using kinds 10/11/12 with the receivedAt receipt clock.

public_api.name: remainingSignals
public_api.description: groupRumorDispatch.ts: remaining() rows as seq-ordered signals, sender = orderingKey.account.

public_api.name: RetractInput / RemainingRow
public_api.signature: RetractInput = GroupRumorInput & {remaining(): Promise<readonly RemainingRow[]>}; RemainingRow = {entry, seq, receivedAt}
public_api.description: history sink retract contract (dispatched && !withdrawing rows, memoised per batch).

public_api.name: purgeHeldReactionsForGroup
public_api.description: reactions/api.ts: drops the group's held reactions; for S13 leave.

dependencies_forbidden: awaiting an account-scope client call inside a handler (follow-up writes enqueue on the FIFO as the last action)
